description: Fixture 2-tagless: Alias gap WITHOUT metadata.type/tags — same referent, different surface forms. Tests whether a memory system without tag-aware supersession can still detect that 'Alice Chen' and 'A. Chen' refer to the same person.
method_note: No metadata.type or tags passed. Entries are natural-language only, submitted in order, one session per entry.

entries.content: Remember that the team lead is Alice Chen.
Remember that the team lead is A. Chen.

expected.question: Should mem-t2-002 supersede mem-t2-001?
expected.design_answer: NO (alias gap: 'Alice Chen' and 'A. Chen' are the same referent; supersession requires identity resolution, which a pure tag-free system may not perform)
expected.note: Both records should remain active unless the system resolves the alias. False-negative detection: a system that blindly supersedes on any write loses the 'Alice Chen' identity.
